senses.gloss: m.(b. h. ספיח; סָפַח)spontaneous growth, after-growth.—Pl. סְפִיחִים, סְפִיחִין, (סְפָ׳).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Sheviit 9:1">Shebi. IX, 1</cite> <he>כל הס׳ מותרין חוץ מסְפִיחֵי כרוב</he> (Y. ed. <he>הספחים … סִפְחֵי</he>) all spontaneous growths (of the Sabbatical year, dating from the sixth year) are permitted, except the after-growth of cabbage; <cite ref="Pesachim 51b:2">Pes. 51ᵇ</cite> <he>כל הס׳ אסורין וכ׳</he> (v. comment.). Sifra B’har, Par. 1, ch. I (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 25:5">Lev. XXV, 5</cite>) <he>מכאן סמכו … הס׳ וכ׳</he> from here the scholars found a support for the prohibition of the after-growth.

<cite ref="Mishnah Shekalim 4:1">Shek. IV, 1</cite> <he>שומרי ס׳ בשביעית וכ׳</he> those appointed to watch the after-growth (of barley for the ‘Omer) in the Sabbatical year receive their wages &c. Y. ib. 48ᵃ top <cite ref="O01344"><he>ספחית</he></cite> (corr. acc.); a. fr.
